ns2:course.label: Proseminar in EPOL
ns2:course.description: Introduces new doctoral students in EPOL to the variety of educational research traditions in order to foster reflective inquiry and critical research literacy. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Admission to a doctorate program in EPOL.
